prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide landscape GitHub README cover for the open-source macOS developer terminal tool devsweep, aspect ratio approximately 2:1.
Primary request: a memorable restrained editorial illustration about reclaiming disk space from developer clutter. A deliberately crafted open-source software identity, legible at GitHub README width.
Scene: warm ivory paper background. To the right, a compact intriguing sculptural pile of obsolete developer artifacts: stacked folder-shaped tiles, small package cubes, miniature simulator phone outlines, and a branching git-worktree symbol. A single purposeful mustard-yellow sweeping ribbon curves around the expendable pile, leaving generous clear space. One upright dark terminal tile with a small green status dot stays separate and undisturbed: the active work is protected. The illustration suggests careful selection, never indiscriminate destruction.
Composition: wide banner, ample breathing room, large lowercase name "devsweep" placed on the left with a small understated terminal prompt symbol nearby; illustration concentrated on the right. No tagline, no fine print. Keep banner height compact.
Style: sophisticated editorial print illustration, bold simplified silhouettes, subtle paper grain, crisp shapes, restrained dimensionality and soft grounded shadows. Precise mature typography with a subtle technical character. Not a generic 3D SaaS illustration.
Palette: warm ivory, charcoal, mustard yellow as dominant accent, minimal green.
Text (verbatim): "devsweep". This is the only word in the image, spelled d e v s w e e p.
Constraints: original art; no borrowed logos, no Apple logo, no Docker logo, no screenshot or fabricated UI, no mascot, no robot, no brain, no badges, no numeric claims, no gradients, no neon glow, no watermark. Communicate developer clutter and deliberate cleanup through the composition.
